[Backend POST send_message + channels] Admin sending channels=['email','sms'] → 200, message persisted in DB. Worker sending same payload → 200, channels silently ignored (no error, message still saved).

[Backend kill-switch gating] With blast_kill_switch ON, admin DM with channels=['email','sms'] still returns 200 and message persists; companion path short-circuits cleanly (no Resend call, no Twilio call).
[Backend DM-only companion] Sending channels=['email','sms'] on a gig_group thread returns 200 and message persists, but companion path is bypassed (no email/SMS attempt).
[Backend Resend safety] Preview Resend key is intentionally invalid — companion email attempts log 'API key is invalid' and are swallowed; in-app delivery always succeeds.
[Regression] threads list, unread-count, mark-as-read, empty-body 400 — all still working.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/messages.py send_message line 444: silently dropping worker-supplied `channels` is correct UX-wise but invisible to the caller. Consider returning the effective channels list in the response body (e.g. response.companion_channels) so the client can show a confirmation 'Sent via in-app, email' vs 'Sent via in-app' — currently no signal back to UI whether email/SMS actually went out.

routes/messages.py _deliver_dm_companion line 458: companion delivery is awaited inline before returning the API response. For DMs that's fine (single recipient, fast), but if Resend or Twilio is slow/timing-out, the HTTP send_message call will block on the third-party round-trip. Consider asyncio.create_task() fire-and-forget like the blast fanout pattern uses.

Messages.jsx QUICK_TEMPLATES: hardcoded English-only templates. If app ever needs i18n, these chip labels and their replacement bodies should move to a translation file / settings collection (low priority).
Frontend Messages.jsx ~line 138: extraChannels reads localStorage on every component mount without a try/catch around JSON.parse. If a user manually corrupts the key it'd crash. Minor.
AdminVAs.jsx: MessageUserButton in row uses variant='row' — confirm width/spacing doesn't overflow on narrow viewports (not tested on mobile here). Visual only.

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Implementation correctly: (1) gates companion email/SMS by sender role (admin/owner/pm) so worker/VA passing channels is silently ignored; (2) bypasses companion path on gig_group threads to avoid mass-spam; (3) respects the blast kill-switch via is_blast_disabled() so a runaway DM-flood can't drain Resend quota during incidents; (4) wraps both _send_email_sync and _send_sms_sync calls in try/except so invalid creds (preview env) don't break in-app delivery; (5) frontend stops event propagation on the icon button so card-body navigation behavior is preserved.
